_comment: Read by the generic session check: /session-start, /session-end, or
ONLY what the checker cannot auto-detect belongs here. It already finds git, npm test,
gas.json (self-deploying script), tools/clasp-auth.js, tools/tracker-audit.js, tools/canary.js and the GitHub ticket list on its
own. A repo whose tests run via `npm test` can delete the `test` key entirely.
The last glob is the session-check skill's own suite. It is listed because nothing ran it:
check.test.js was red on master for weeks (issue 300). CI runs it too, and from a copy
outside the checkout as well, which is the run that catches a test assuming where the skill
is installed -- .github/workflows/skill-tests.yml. Nothing in that suite may run check.js
against THIS repo root: check.js runs the command below, so that would re-enter it forever.
PRESERVE THIS FILE ON UPGRADE. Same rule as build-dashboard.js's CONFIG block: the test command
here is frequently hand-corrected (aac-bill-intake needs an explicit file list because
`node --test gas/` does not work there), and detection cannot reproduce that.
test: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/restore-test.ps1 -From worktree && node --test tests/*.test.js tools/*.test.js aac-skills/session-check/*.test.js
note: Release here is the push to origin/master - that is what a container installs; a desktop takes skills and rules through the aac-skills plugin (claude plugin marketplace update, then claude plugin update) and the rest of the profile through sync.ps1 -Mode pull. Nothing here is generated from a live tree any more (issue 214): edit aac-skills/ for skills and profile/ for the consumer profile, on a branch, and let CI stamp and rebuild the plugin payload.
